name: Manila shipping tag
where_seen: Wired or strung through a reinforced eyelet onto pulled parts on warehouse shelves and onto repair-shop work in progress.
texture: Matte 13-point buff card with faint fibre fleck; a darker fibre-patch ring reinforces the 3/16 in eyelet at one short end, corners clipped at that end.
css: background: radial-gradient(circle at 14px 50%, #2a2018 0 3px, #b08a55 3px 8px, transparent 8.5px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(120,90,40,.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), #E3C690;
notes: Sourced: #5 size 4-3/4 x 2-3/8 in, 13 pt (also 10 pt) board, reinforced eyelet, 12 in of 26-gauge wire. Hex values and clipped corners are estimates, unverified.

name: Yellow Tyvek wire tag
where_seen: Wired to parts stored outdoors or oily, where a paper tag would rot or tear.
texture: Matte spunbonded olefin with a visible swirled random-fibre mottle, slightly translucent at the edges; a 3/16 in metal eyelet and twisted double wire.
css: background: radial-gradient(circle at 14px 50%, #3a3a3a 0 3px, #b8bcc0 3px 6px, transparent 6.5px), repeating-linear-gradient(37deg, rgba(255,255,255,.14) 0 2px, transparent 2px 7px), repeating-linear-gradient(-58deg, rgba(160,120,0,.08) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px), #F4D21F;
notes: Sourced: spunbonded olefin resisting chemicals/mildew/moisture; 3/16 in metal eyelet; 26 ga double wire 12 in; stock colours white, yellow, orange, red, blue, green; sizes 2-3/4 x 1-3/8 to 6-1/4 x 3-1/8 in. No source maps a colour to a meaning in salvage yards (shop-defined). Hex and fibre-swirl description unverified.

name: Inspection tag: rejected (red)
where_seen: Hung on parts that failed inspection or are scrap, in shop quality-control and parts-return areas.
texture: Flat matte coloured cardstock, solid colour both sides, with a bold condensed capital headline over ruled write-in lines.
css: background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 12px, #2a1a1a 0 3px, #f2e6d8 3px 7px, transparent 7.5px), repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 21px, rgba(0,0,0,.35) 21px 22px), #D62828;
notes: Sourced: catalogue convention Rejected/Non-Conforming = red, Hold = yellow, OK to Use/Accepted = green, Inspected = yellow; 4-3/4 x 2-3/8 in 13 pt; red = scrap in aviation tagging. Convention is supplier/industry habit, not a regulation. Hex unverified.

name: Inspection tag: hold (yellow)
where_seen: Hung on parts waiting for a decision, rework or a customer in shop holding areas.
texture: Flat matte yellow cardstock with black headline and ruled fields; no gloss.
css: background: linear-gradient(180deg, #111 0 26%, transparent 26%), repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 21px, rgba(0,0,0,.3) 21px 22px), #FFD400;
notes: Sourced: Hold = yellow and Inspected = yellow in industrial catalogues; black-on-yellow Re-Work tags exist; in aviation a yellow tag instead means serviceable (meanings conflict across industries). Black header band is a design choice, unverified.

name: Inspection tag: accepted (green)
where_seen: Hung on parts cleared for use or sale after inspection.
texture: Flat matte green cardstock with a bold capital headline and ruled fields.
notes: Sourced: Accepted / OK to Use = green in industrial catalogues; aviation sources disagree (green = repairable in the US, serviceable in Canada). Hex unverified.

name: Yellow paint marker on steel
where_seen: Stock numbers and vehicle details hand-lettered straight onto pulled parts, engine blocks and glass in salvage yards.
texture: Opaque glossy enamel line with rounded ends and uneven width, sitting on dull grey cast metal or rust; ball-tip markers leave a slightly raised bead.
css: background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 30%, rgba(138,75,34,.35), transparent 55%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 75%, rgba(0,0,0,.25), transparent 60%), repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,255,255,.03) 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px), #4A4A48; color: #FFD21A;
notes: Sourced (retail listing and forums, anecdotal): yellow is the customary salvage-yard marker colour; metal ball-point squeeze bottles (2 oz) mark greasy, oily or rusty parts. No formal standard found. Hex values unverified.

name: Tire crayon on rubber
where_seen: Sizes, positions and stock numbers chalked on tire sidewalls and treads in tire and repair shops.
texture: Waxy, broken, slightly translucent stroke about 1/2 in wide that skips over the sidewall ribs of matte black rubber.
css: background: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 6px), linear-gradient(180deg, #262627, #171718); color: #F3F1EA;
notes: Sourced: wax crayons 1/2 x 4-5/8 in, sold in white and yellow; mark wet, cold, smooth or coarse rubber, metal, glass; semi-permanent but rub off. Hex and stroke appearance unverified.

name: Soapstone on plate steel
where_seen: Cut lines and part numbers scratched on steel stock and frames in fabrication and body shops.
texture: Thin, dusty, chalk-like grey-white line on blue-grey mill-scale steel with a soft satin sheen.
css: background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(255,255,255,.06), transparent 40%, rgba(255,255,255,.04) 70%, transparent), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,.06) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px), #3B3F45; color: #D9DCD6;
notes: Sourced: talc sticks, flat 1/16 x 1/2 x 5 in, marks temporary like chalk and do not burn off under heat. Hex values unverified.

name: Chartreuse windshield numbers
where_seen: Large stick-on year and price digits across the windshield of vehicles on a sales lot.
texture: Flat fluorescent lime-yellow vinyl, die-cut heavy block digits, no gradient; reads against dark glass.
notes: Sourced: adhesive digits 5-1/2, 7-1/2 (7-1/2 x 4 in) and 11-1/2 in tall, colour named chartreuse / fluorescent lime-yellow; a white-and-blue variant exists. Here the 'base' is the digit colour shown on dark glass (css). Hex unverified.

name: Stock-number window sticker
where_seen: Small coloured sticker on the inside of a windshield corner carrying the vehicle's stock number in marker.
texture: Smooth semi-gloss coloured label, about 3 x 4 in, with a pre-printed heading and one large blank for a hand-written number.
css: background: linear-gradient(180deg, #111 0 18%, transparent 18%), linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.25), transparent 45%), #FFE500;
notes: Sourced: 3 x 4 in self-adhering stock stickers for the inside of the windshield, sold in yellow, blue, orange, red. Layout (header band) and hex unverified.

name: Poly key tag
where_seen: Ringed to the keys of every stocked vehicle on a key board, pre-printed with fields filled in by marker.
texture: Thin semi-gloss plastic strip with small black pre-printed field labels and a plated split ring through a punched hole.
css: background: radial-gradient(circle at 12px 50%, #f6f6f2 0 4px, #9aa0a6 4px 6px, transparent 6.5px), repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 13px, rgba(0,0,0,.35) 13px 14px), #FFE14A;
notes: Sourced: pre-printed fields New/Used, Stk#, Year, Make, Model, Color, Series, VIN; colours yellow, white, purple, green, grey, orange; about 1.3 x 2.8 in (self-laminating folds to 1-1/4 x 3 in); 7/8 in plated rings. Hex unverified.

name: Embossed label tape
where_seen: Stuck on bin fronts, drawer edges and tool cabinets in parts rooms: raised white capitals on a coloured strip.
texture: Glossy 3/8 in vinyl strip; letters are raised and turn chalky white where the plastic is stretched, with soft halos and a specular highlight along the top edge.
css: background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.38) 0 12%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,.18) 100%), #C8102E; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.8); letter-spacing: .18em;
notes: Sourced: 3/8 in x 12 ft glossy adhesive-backed vinyl, 0.007 in thick, white-on-red / -blue / -black. The stress-whitening mechanism and all hex values (black #0A0A0A, blue ~#1746A2) are unverified.

name: Write-on aluminium tag
where_seen: Wired to parts that get hot, washed or left outside; the number is pressed in with a ballpoint or stylus.
texture: Dead-soft foil over tagboard with a dull satin sheen; writing is a debossed groove read by shadow, not ink.
css: background: radial-gradient(circle at 14px 50%, #2b2b2b 0 3px, #eef0f2 3px 6px, transparent 6.5px), linear-gradient(105deg, #b9bdc1 0%, #e6e8ea 28%, #c2c6ca 52%, #dcdfe2 74%, #b4b8bc 100%); color: #6E7378; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7), 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25);
notes: Sourced: 0.020 in (24 ga) double-sided soft aluminium laminated over tagboard; 2 x 4, 1-3/8 x 3-1/8, 0.75 x 3 in; 3/16 in plain or eyelet hole; wired dead-soft versions up to 5 x 3 in. Hex values unverified.

name: Stamped data plate
where_seen: Riveted to a vehicle body or a component housing, carrying the identification number in struck characters.
texture: Thin steel or anodised aluminium plate, satin black or bare metal, with evenly struck monospaced characters and a rosette-head rivet at each end.
css: background: radial-gradient(circle at 10px 50%, #d5d8db 0 2px, #7d8287 2px 5px, transparent 5.5px), radial-gradient(circle at calc(100% - 10px) 50%, #d5d8db 0 2px, #7d8287 2px 5px, transparent 5.5px), linear-gradient(180deg, #34373a, #232527); color: #C7CACD; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.8), 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.15);
notes: Sourced: rosette (5- or 6-point star-head) rivets fix identification plates from about the mid-1960s; plates are steel or anodised aluminium (also stainless, brass); factory stamping is even in depth, font and spacing. Black finish and hex values unverified.

name: Stack-and-hang bin (blue)
where_seen: Rows of open-front plastic bins hung on louvred panels or stacked on parts-room shelving, each with a card in a front label slot.
texture: Moulded polypropylene with a low waxy sheen, vertical stiffening ribs and a recessed white card slot on the front lip.
css: background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.22) 0 8%, transparent 8% 100%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.14) 0 2px, transparent 2px 28px), linear-gradient(180deg, #2a6ed1, #184c9c);
notes: Sourced: high-density polypropylene; colours blue, red, yellow, semi-clear white, black, clear; moulded front label slot taking card inserts; rear full-width hanger for louvred panels; sizes from 5-3/8 x 4-1/8 x 3 in to 16 x 11 x 8 in. Hex (red ~#C9252B, yellow ~#F2C200) and ribs unverified.

name: Masking tape and marker
where_seen: A torn strip stuck on a part, a bin or a shelf edge with a number in black marker.
texture: Matte crepe paper with fine cross-wise wrinkles, slightly translucent, ends torn ragged; marker ink feathers a little into the crepe.
css: background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(120,95,45,.10) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.18), transparent 30%, rgba(0,0,0,.05)), #E4D2A4;
notes: Sourced: natural/beige/tan crepe-paper backing, 1 in x 60 yd, backing accepts pen, pencil and marker, sold for labelling. Hex and wrinkle direction unverified.

name: Hardboard pegboard
where_seen: The wall behind a parts counter or bench, with tagged parts and tools hung on hooks.
texture: Smooth tempered brown hardboard with a faint satin sheen and a square grid of round holes 1 in on centre.
notes: Sourced: brown tempered hardboard, 1/8 to 1/4 in thick, holes 1/4 in nominal (9/32 in actual) on 1 in centres; white-faced version exists. Hex unverified.

name: Static-cling service reminder
where_seen: A 2 in square in the top corner of a windshield with a next-service date and mileage written in.
texture: Clear or white glossy cling film, no adhesive, printed with a heading and two ruled write-in lines; rolls are perforated between stickers.
css: background: linear-gradient(180deg, #C8102E 0 22%, transparent 22%), repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 17px, rgba(0,0,0,.4) 17px 18px), linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.9), rgba(235,238,240,.9));
notes: Sourced: 2 x 2 in, clear or white, static cling without adhesive, on perforated rolls, with write-in areas for date, mileage and oil grade under a 'next service due' heading. Red header band and hex unverified.
